newsitem.title: NORWAY: New rig concept wins N.Sea oil innovation award.
newsitem.headline: New rig concept wins N.Sea oil innovation award.

text.p: Norway's Maritime Hydraulics AS was awarded the 1996 innovation award at the Offshore Northern Seas (ONS) conference and exhibition, for its RamRig drilling rig design, ONS officials said on Wednesday.
The lightweight hydraulic drilling rig eliminates the need for a large derrick and can be used for both fixed and floating installations.
Farouk Al-Khasim, President of the award committee, said that the Ramrig concept was an "effective, cost-efficient and environmentally friendly method of drilling."
Vice President of Maritime Hydraulics, Paal Norheim, said that the concept was more effective than traditional drilling equipment, especially in deeper waters.
"It saves a week in drilling time per well and there is no need for people in the derrick," Norheim said.
